en-US.description: A powerful tool for translating Help+Manual documentation projects
en-US.longDescription:
Help+Manual Translation Assistant (HMTA) is a powerful tool for translating Help+Manual documentation projects. It has all the features translators need to perform both original translations and updates.

Includes AI-based DeepL machine translation
  The regular translation features are combined with the amazing power of DeepL machine translation. Powered by advanced artificial intelligence systems, DeepL produces translations that are massively better than anything you have seen before. Where machine translation used to be more of a joke, with DeepL you get a genuinely usable translation that usually only requires minimal editing. Professional translators have described the results as "frighteningly good".
  Using DeepL can save you well over 90% of your regular translation costs and time.

Key features of Help+Manual Translation Assistant
- Side-by-side views and comparisons of the original project and the translation
- DeepL machine translation with bulk translation of the entire project
- Side-by side views with content comparison of old and new original for updating translations
- WYSIWYG editor with full support for Help+Manual formatting and styles tools
en-US.name: Help+Manual Translation Assistant

zh-CN.description: 一款强大的 Help+Manual 文档翻译工具
zh-CN.longDescription:
Help+Manual 翻译助手 (HMTA)是一款强大的 Help+Manual 文档项目翻译工具。它集成了翻译人员执行初始翻译和更新所需的所有功能。

包含基于 AI 的 DeepL 机器翻译
  常规翻译功能与强大的 DeepL 机器翻译相结合。依托先进的人工智能系统，DeepL 生成的翻译质量远超您以往所见。过去机器翻译常被视为笑谈，而 DeepL 能提供真正可用的译文，通常只需稍加修改即可。专业译员评价其效果“好到令人惊讶”。
  使用 DeepL 可节省 90% 以上的常规翻译成本和时间。

Help+Manual 翻译助手核心功能
- 原文与译文的并排视图对比
- 支持整批翻译整个项目的 DeepL 机器翻译
- 新旧原文内容对比的并排视图（用于翻译更新）
- 所见即所得编辑器，完整支持 Help+Manual 格式和样式工具
